title: Lamar Blvd Zoning & Street Name Shake-Up
summary:
*   A contentious zoning request near the new Lamar Boulevard was denied, preventing the sale of beer and liquor in the area due to public, City Plan Commission, and State Highway Department concerns about traffic and "objectionable practices."
*   The city moved forward with acquiring land for the new Lamar Boulevard right-of-way, offering $1500 to a property owner, with a plan for condemnation if an agreement isn't reached.
*   Major infrastructure projects were approved, including the installation of new gas mains across several city streets and the formal transfer of a $34,632 construction contract for the Brackenridge Hospital Nurses' Home addition.
*   To improve city navigation and clarity, the council officially changed the names of 11 streets, including renaming "Splitrock Avenue" to "Wooldridge Drive" and "Lake Boulevard" to "Scenic Drive."
